basics.name: Yujin Bae
basics.label: M.S. Student in Robotics, KAIST
basics.summary: My long-term goal is to build proactive assistive AI for embodied settings such as smart glasses and robotic hands. Toward this end, I focus on multimodal understanding of how humans interact with their surroundings, and I aim to extend this understanding to robot learning as a next step.

projects.position: Full-Body Motion Prediction from Sparse Observations via Expert Distillation
projects.name: Visual Intelligence Lab, KAIST
highlights: Developing a lightweight model that forecasts future motion from sparse observations via on-policy distillation, jointly decoding action intent as text to disambiguate multimodal futures

projects.position: Development of Core Technologies for Autonomous Driving in Unstructured Off-Road Environments
projects.name: Funded by Hanwha Aerospace
highlights: Contributed to a moving object tracking algorithm that fuses LiDAR, Radar, and RGB sensors for robust perception in unstructured off-road environments
Collected robot driving datasets (ROS bag) across off-road and diverse operational settings, and annotated 2D bounding box tracks of moving objects

work.name: HCI Tech Lab, Graduate School of Culture Technology, KAIST
highlights: Contributed to a hand pressure estimation algorithm augmenting forearm sEMG with 3D hand posture, surveying existing 3D hand pose estimation methods and integrating them into the end-to-end pipeline
